meta.notes: This dataset covers the Azoth wallet currency (used for fast travel, some crafting, and weapon-mastery respecs) on official Amazon New World: Aeternum servers. Azoth Salt is a separate PvP-track currency introduced in the May 25, 2022 Arenas update and is not included in the wallet cap or cost tables. Official patch notes last published a flat 20 Azoth fast-travel cost and a 30-minute inn recall on February 25, 2022 (live February 28, 2022), after removing distance and encumbrance surcharges. Multiple independent guides dated May–October 2024 instead report 10 Azoth within a territory and 20 Azoth leaving a territory, and 15-minute inn recalls; no official patch text for that later split or cooldown cut was found. The Aeternum launch (Season of Opportunity, October 14–15, 2024) and the April 21, 2026 maintenance (permanent 2x XP, house ownership raised to five at level 55+, gold inventory cap 10 million, gypsum/umbral limit changes, Elysian Wilds MSQ-gate removal) do not list Azoth cost or wallet-cap changes. Any number that predates those patches is flagged with outdated_risk when later official confirmation is missing. Live nwdb.info and some guide pages are undated; source_date is null in those cases, with a note that the page was accessed on 2026-11-15. Never-invented values are stored as null.
meta.scope: official Amazon servers; Project Azoth private server values unpublished

costs.name: Fast travel within the same territory
costs.conditions: Start at a discovered settlement, outpost, or shrine (or from inside a settlement) and travel to another discovered sanctuary in the same territory. Waived entirely if your faction owns the Restless Shores fort (see fast_travel_restless_shores_fort).
costs.patch_or_season: Reported in guides by 2024 (pre-Aeternum and Aeternum launch). Official February 2022 notes still said a flat 20 for all shrine/town travel; no official patch text for the 10/20 split was found.
costs.notes: Independent confirmation: Sportskeeda, 2024-10-19, https://www.sportskeeda.com/mmo/new-world-aeternum-how-recall-fast-travel (10 in-region, 20 leaving the region). GameRant, 2024-10-15, mentions only a 10 Azoth cost and does not split in-region vs out-of-region. Official February 2022 baseline of a flat 20 Azoth with no distance or weight adjustment is at https://www.newworld.com/en-us/news/articles/new-world-february-2022-update (published 2022-02-25, live 2022-02-28). April 21, 2026 maintenance notes reviewed via press coverage do not mention a travel-cost change.

costs.name: Fast travel out of the current territory
costs.conditions: Start at a discovered settlement, outpost, or shrine and travel to a discovered sanctuary in a different territory. Waived if your faction owns the Restless Shores fort.
costs.patch_or_season: Same as fast_travel_within_territory. The official February 2022 cost was already a flat 20 Azoth for all shrine/town travel.
costs.notes: Also Sportskeeda, 2024-10-19. Official February 2022 wording: 'Fast-travel from Towns and Shrines will now have a base cost of 20 Azoth. There are no longer cost adjustments for distance or weight.' Destination must have been visited first (GameRant, 2024-10-15).

costs.name: Distance and encumbrance fast-travel surcharge
costs.conditions: Removed. Pre-February 2022 travel added Azoth based on distance and carried weight on top of a higher base cost. January 25, 2022 first reduced the distance factor (and made the relevant Faction Control Point bonus zero out that factor); February 28, 2022 removed both adjustments.
costs.patch_or_season: January Update (Mutators), 2022-01-25, then February Update, live 2022-02-28
costs.notes: January 25, 2022 official notes: https://www.newworld.com/en-us/game/releases/january-update-mutators. Older wiki/fandom pages that still describe distance-plus-weight pricing are outdated. No later official note restored those surcharges.

costs.name: Fast travel while your faction owns the Restless Shores fort
costs.conditions: Your faction must currently control the Restless Shores fort. Official May 2022 wording is that all fast travel is free. Later guides describe this as a 100% Azoth-cost reduction and sometimes as free travel in your territory; the official 2022 note is broader ('all fast travel is now free').
costs.notes: Still listed as 'Free Fast Travel -100%' in a September 8, 2025 fort-bonus guide: https://thexamxam.com/2025/09/new-world-aeternum-fort-capture-and-faction-bonuses-guide/. Sportskeeda (2024-10-19) and High Ground Gaming (updated 2024-05-21) also still describe the bonus. Fort bonuses have been remapped in later seasons, so the exact scope (all travel vs in-territory only) could have narrowed; official 2022 text is the last Amazon wording found.

costs.name: Recall to checked-in Inn
costs.conditions: Check in at one inn at a time. Recall from anywhere (map: Recall to Inn) out of combat. Cooldown: Aeternum-era guides say 15 minutes; official notes last stated 30 minutes (reduced from 1 hour on 2022-02-28). Cannot spend Azoth to clear the inn cooldown (High Ground Gaming, 2024-05-21).
costs.patch_or_season: Official cooldown cut in February 2022 (1 hour to 30 minutes). 15-minute figure appears in October 2024 Aeternum launch guides; no official patch text for that later cut was found.
costs.notes: Cost is free in all sources checked. Official February 2022 note: 'Default recall time to the Inn has been reduced from 1 hour to 30 minutes' (https://www.newworld.com/en-us/news/articles/new-world-february-2022-update, 2022-02-25). Sportskeeda, 2024-10-19, also says every fifteen minutes. Fandom and some undated guides still say 60 minutes and are outdated relative to both official 2022 and 2024 guides.

costs.name: Recall to an owned house
costs.conditions: House must be owned and property tax paid; unpaid tax disables house recall (official housing article). Each house has its own cooldown. Official May 11, 2021 tiers: T1 4 hours, T2 3 hours, T3 2.5 hours, T4 2 hours. You can pay Azoth to clear a remaining cooldown (see house_cooldown_reset). After April 21, 2026, characters at level 55+ may own up to five houses (was three).
costs.patch_or_season: Housing tiers: Explore with Player Titles, 2021-05-11. House cap 5: April 21, 2026 maintenance.
costs.notes: Recall itself is free in official housing coverage (https://www.newworld.com/en-us/news/articles/making-your-mark-on-aeternum-player-housing, 2020-02-20) and the official returning-player guide (https://www.newworld.com/en-us/news/articles/tips-from-aeternum-new-and-returning-player-guide, 2022-10-21). No official post-2021 confirmation of the 4h/3h/2.5h/2h cooldown table was found. House-count change: https://massivelyop.com/2026/04/21/new-world-doubles-experience-rates-and-lets-remaining-players-buy-five-houses-a-pop/ and https://www.mmorpg.com/news/new-world-aeternum-will-loosen-more-restrictions-turn-on-xp-bonus-to-let-remaining-players-access-content-2000137857 (2026-04-20/21). Those 2026 notes do not mention a house-recall Azoth or cooldown change.

costs.name: Reset house-recall cooldown
costs.conditions: Pay to clear the remaining recall cooldown on a specific owned house. Official February 2022 note presents this as a flat 20 Azoth (reduced from 50). Older wiki text that scales 10–50 Azoth with remaining cooldown predates that official flattening.
costs.notes: Official wording: 'Reduced cost of resetting fast-travel cooldown on houses from 50 Azoth to 20 Azoth.' No later official number was found. The official returning-player guide (2022-10-21) only says 'a small Azoth fee.' Fandom Fast Travel page still describes a 10–50 range and should be treated as outdated relative to the February 2022 notes.

costs.name: War or Outpost Rush entry
costs.conditions: No Azoth entry fee was found in official mode notes. This is not a claim that hidden costs cannot exist.
costs.notes: Official February 2022 and May 2022 game-mode notes discuss Outpost Rush and War rewards, scoring, and (in January 2022) summoning-stone Azoth costs, but they do not list an Azoth cost to queue or enter. Amount left null.

costs.name: Outpost Rush Brute summoning token
costs.conditions: Spending Azoth in Outpost Rush to obtain a Brute summoning token. Not a travel cost.
costs.notes: Official wording: 'Increased the Azoth cost of Brute tokens from 500 Azoth to 750 Azoth.' Update 1.0.5 (2021-11-03) had previously mentioned 500 Azoth per token. No post-2022 official confirmation of the 750 figure was found; treat as possibly changed.

costs.name: Optional Azoth investment when crafting equipment
costs.conditions: When crafting weapons or armor, players may spend Azoth to increase the chance of a perk, a gem slot, or both. Official text says more Azoth raises the chance but does not guarantee the outcome, and that the maximum spend depends on the item. No official current slider caps (per tier or gear score) were found.
costs.patch_or_season: Described in the official crafting article; last minor official update May 11, 2021. Later patches have changed specific recipe Azoth costs (see Eternal Frost).
costs.notes: The official article (originally 2020-06-10, updated 2021-05-11) confirms the mechanic but publishes no numbers. Player reports from October 2024 that some T5+ crafts require 500 Azoth were not used as a confirmed amount. See also procedural_expansion_perk_azoth and matrix component costs.

costs.name: Azoth cost for perks on procedural expansion crafts
costs.conditions: Official Eternal Frost note applies to 'perks on Procedural expansion crafts,' raised from 15 to 150 Azoth. Scope is expansion-era procedural crafts, not every recipe in the game.
costs.notes: Aeternum (October 14, 2024) simplified Scarab recipes and may have changed related Azoth spends; no official replacement number for this 150 figure was found. Same Eternal Frost notes also said Golden and Prismatic Scarab recipes were reduced 'so a player can do 2 full crafts with a bank of 1000 Azoth on a Tier 5 crafting station' (implies at most 500 Azoth per full scarab craft at that time, but that is not an exact recipe cost and is not recorded as a number here).

costs.name: Matrix component craft (e.g. Blessed Rivets)
costs.conditions: Each listed matrix component recipe (Blessed Rivets and the other published component crafts) spends 250 Azoth plus prismatic materials and gypsum orbs. Two components are needed for a matrix. This is a wallet-Azoth spend at the station, separate from any Vials of Suspended Azoth listed in completed-matrix ingredient totals.
costs.patch_or_season: Matrices were introduced with Rise of the Angry Earth / Season 3 (2023). Ingredient lists cited from a guide last updated 2025-07-01.
costs.notes: Blessed Rivets specifically: 2 Prismatic Ingot, 2 Prismatic Block, 15 Powerful Gemstone Dust, 5 Gypsum Orb, 250 Azoth, Jewelcrafting 250, Outfitting Station tier II, per https://new-world.guide/db/item/matrixcomponent_blessedrivets (page undated; accessed 2026-11-15). The same July 1, 2025 guide lists 15 Vials of Suspended Azoth in some completed-matrix total-ingredient breakdowns; that vial count was not independently confirmed on a live recipe page and is not recorded as a wallet cost here.

costs.name: Topaz Gypsum Attunement Potion craft
costs.conditions: Published recipe ingredients are alchemy critters (and related materials), crafted once per 24 hours at a Tier 5 camp or Tier 2 Arcane Repository. No Azoth ingredient appears in the cited recipe.
costs.patch_or_season: Gypsum system / January 2022 notes allow crafting the Topaz potion at Arcana stations or T5 camps. Recipe snapshot is from an older nwdb mirror.
costs.notes: Source page is undated (older nwdb.info snapshot; accessed 2026-11-15). Official January 25, 2022 notes confirm the potion can be crafted at Arcana or a T5 camp (https://www.newworld.com/en-us/game/releases/january-update-mutators) but do not list ingredients. Other colored gypsum attunement methods were not fully surveyed; no Azoth cost was found for gypsum attunement potions.

costs.name: Weapon mastery tree respec
costs.conditions: Official character-progression article says weapon mastery trees can be respecced 'in exchange for some Azoth.' Launch-era guides said the first respecs were free until around weapon mastery 10, then Azoth was charged. Update 1.0.5 reduced weapon-mastery respec Azoth cost by 75%, without publishing the resulting table. No reliable current per-level amounts were found, so amount is null.
costs.patch_or_season: Described 2020–2021; cost reduced 75% in Update 1.0.5 (live 2021-11-04). Later undocumented retunes possible.
costs.notes: Official 1.0.5: https://www.newworld.com/en-us/news/articles/new-world-update-1-0-5 (2021-11-03). GameWatcher (2021-10-05) stated respecs are free early and cost Azoth after weapon level 10 (https://www.gamewatcher.com/new-world-respec-cost) but published no complete current table. Pre-1.0.5 community tables (for example 50 Azoth at mastery 20) are not recorded here because they predate the 75% official cut and have not been reconfirmed.

costs.name: Attribute respec
costs.conditions: Attribute respecs are a coin fee, not an Azoth fee. Official 1.0.5 reduced the attribute respec coin cost by 60%. The respec is often described as free in the early levels, then a coin cost that scales with character level. This record exists so the fee is not mistaken for an Azoth spend.
costs.patch_or_season: Update 1.0.5, 2021-11-03 (live 2021-11-04). Official progression article (updated 2021-05-11) only says 'a small fee' that increases with level.
costs.notes: Amount 0 means 0 Azoth, not 0 coin. No official current coin table was found, so coin amounts are not recorded. Character progression: https://www.newworld.com/en-us/news/articles/character-progression (2021-05-11).

costs.name: Expedition or mutator tuning orb craft or faction-shop purchase
costs.conditions: Official orb-craft and shop notes describe coin, chisels, corrupted materials, runestones, gemstone dust, weekly craft limits, and faction-token purchases. No Azoth ingredient or Azoth purchase price was found.
costs.patch_or_season: January Update - Mutators, 2022-01-25, and later economy notes
costs.notes: Amount is null because no Azoth cost was documented, not because a zero cost was officially published. Later seasons added more expeditions and may have changed recipes.

earn.method: Main story and side quest rewards
earn.level_range: varies; not every quest pays Azoth
earn.patch_or_season: Ongoing; individual quest rewards have been retuned with starting-experience overhauls, including Aeternum (October 2024).
earn.notes: Aeternum launch guides say main and side quests are a primary Azoth source while leveling, but they publish no typical amounts. Launch-era claims of 'as much as 500 Azoth' from some quests (Game8 and TheGamer, 2021) were not reconfirmed on the live database; the often-cited 'Between Innkeeps' 500-Azoth quest was not found on current nwdb.info. Do not treat 500 as a current typical reward. A concrete current example is recorded separately as earn id an_order_reborn (50 Azoth).

earn.method: Main story quest 'An Order Reborn' (forges the Azoth Staff)
earn.patch_or_season: Current Aeternum quest name; same quest id as the older 'Reignition' snapshot (99a_msq_11_forgestaff).
earn.notes: Live nwdb.info lists rewards of 4,000 XP, 269.50 coin, 50 Azoth, an Azoth Staff (T1), and 5 Common Health Potions. The page is undated (accessed 2026-11-15). An older isabella.nwdb.info snapshot named 'Reignition' listed only 10 Azoth for the same quest id, so the 50 figure appears to be a later retune and should be rechecked if the database snapshot changes.

earn.patch_or_season: Town Maintenance category added in the May 11, 2021 'Explore with player titles' notes
earn.notes: No published Azoth reward for town-board missions was found. Official 2021 notes discuss town projects and standing, not Azoth payouts. Amount left null.

Official May 2022 notes mention elite-chest odds for umbral shards (15% chance to drop 50 umbral), not Azoth. No reliable current Azoth or vial drop rate or amount for elite chests was found. An older community loot discussion is not used as a number here.

earn.method: Closing Corruption Breaches (requires an Azoth Staff)
earn.level_range: Staff is obtained around the mid-20s (An Order Reborn is suggested level 24); higher-tier staffs close higher-level breaches
earn.patch_or_season: Breaches converted to Elite content in the May 11, 2021 notes; still tied to the Azoth Staff in current quest data
earn.notes: Guides consistently say successful breach closes can reward Azoth (and territory standing / caches), but no official or current numeric payout was found. TheGamer (2021-12-05) only says there is a chance of Azoth. Amount left null. Official January 2022 notes also increased the chance that major-breach caches grant an expertise bump, which is unrelated to Azoth amounts.

earn.method: Azoth Springs / Azoth Water gathering nodes
earn.notes: These nodes yield Azoth Water, a crafting material, not wallet Azoth. They are recorded so the two are not confused. The gatherable page is undated (accessed 2026-11-15). Do not treat published Azoth Water stack sizes or gather yields as currency income.

earn.method: Gathering any node with an Azoth Extraction tool perk
earn.per: per successful perk proc (not per gather)
earn.level_range: Available on gathering tools; proc chance scales with the tool's gear score
earn.patch_or_season: Current live perk data on nwdb.info (undated page, accessed 2026-11-15)
earn.notes: Live nwdb.info page is undated (accessed 2026-11-15). At the 800 gear-score setting the perk reads '+55% chance to gain 1 Azoth when gathering a node.' The chance scales with gear score; lower-GS values were not copied because the full curve was not recorded. Launch-era guides that say a 30% chance, or that the perk grants a vial rather than 1 Azoth, are outdated relative to this live tooltip. Craft mod: Drop of Azoth Oil. Compatible with logging axe, skinning knife, sickle, and pickaxe.

earn.method: Bonus Azoth from the Azoth Attuned bag perk
earn.patch_or_season: Current live perk data on nwdb.info (undated page, accessed 2026-11-15)
earn.notes: Live nwdb.info page is undated (accessed 2026-11-15). At the 800 gear-score setting the tooltip reads 'When you gain Azoth, gain 5.5% more' (internal modifier 5.54545%). The perk scales with gear score, is compatible with bags, and has max stack 3. Older figures such as 3% (TheGamer, 2021-12-05) or 4.8% on an older Vial of Azoth Oil tooltip are outdated relative to this live 800-GS value. This is a percentage modifier, not a flat earn amount, so rough_amount is null.

earn.patch_or_season: Explore with player titles, 2021-05-11, rebalanced missions toward reputation and faction tokens; daily bonuses on the first 3 missions
earn.notes: Official 2021 rebalance says rewards were 'focused more around gaining faction tokens' and lists reputation, tokens, XP, and coin. No current Azoth payout was found. Amount left null.

earn.method: Enemy kills, including Ancient / glowing enemies
earn.level_range: Guides describe this as more relevant at mid and high levels
earn.patch_or_season: Launch-era guides; not reconfirmed with current drop tables
earn.notes: Multiple older guides say some enemies can drop Azoth, with Ancient or 'blue glow' enemies called out more often. No reliable current amount or drop chance was found. Sportskeeda (2024-10-19) still says Azoth can be farmed by gathering and defeating enemies, without amounts. Amount left null. Source is outdated; mechanic is only 'likely' still present.

earn.method: Salvage or open a Vial of Suspended Azoth
earn.patch_or_season: Explore with player titles, 2021-05-11, changed vials from 13 to 50 Azoth. Still 50 on live nwdb.info in 2026.
earn.notes: Official wording: 'Azoths Vial now provide 50 Azoth instead of 13.' Live item page https://nwdb.info/db/item/azurevialt1 (undated, accessed 2026-11-15) still says the vial gives 50 Azoth when salvaged. Official 1.6.1 / community-manager notes in 2022 described salvage-all opening only enough vials to reach the wallet cap, so excess is not wasted if you are already near cap. Vials can drop from enemies or rewards and can be traded; trading-post coin prices are not recorded here.

earn.method: Trade-skill aptitude chests (Vials of Suspended Azoth)
earn.patch_or_season: January Update - Mutators, 2022-01-25, reduced vial counts in aptitude chests
earn.notes: Official January 2022 figures, not recorded as current amounts because later seasons almost certainly retuned aptitude loot: vials removed from T1 gathering chests; T2 gathering 1–2; T3 gathering 1–3; T1 crafting/refining 0–1; T2 1–2; T3 2–3. Use only as historical context. Each vial is 50 Azoth when salvaged.

earn.per: per run or per expedition quest
earn.patch_or_season: Aeternum added new repeatable expedition quests (Season of Opportunity, 2024-10-14); Azoth amounts not listed in those notes
earn.notes: TheGamer (2021-12-05) claimed expedition quests and mobs can yield Azoth, without amounts. Official Aeternum notes mention repeatable expedition quests and coin-reward changes, not Azoth. Amount left null.

caps.name: Azoth wallet cap
caps.notes: Official Eternal Frost wording: 'Raised the Azoth cap from 1,000 to 2,500.' Player discussions on 2024-12-02, 2024-12-09, and 2025-09-12 still treat 2,500 as the live cap. The April 21, 2026 maintenance raised the inventory gold cap to 10 million and other limits, but press summaries of those notes do not mention a new Azoth cap. Launch-era guides that still say 1,000 are outdated.

caps.name: Vial of Suspended Azoth maximum stack size
caps.notes: Live nwdb.info item page (undated, accessed 2026-11-15) lists Max Stack: 10000. This is an item-stack cap, not a wallet cap. Each vial contains 50 Azoth.

spend_tips.tip: Set an inn in the zone you are working and recall to it for free before paying for shrine travel.
spend_tips.reason: Inn recall costs 0 Azoth and can be used from anywhere, unlike shrine travel. Official notes and Aeternum guides agree it is free; only the cooldown length is disputed (official 30 minutes in 2022 vs 15 minutes in October 2024 guides).

spend_tips.tip: Use owned houses as additional free recall points, especially after the April 21, 2026 five-house limit.
spend_tips.reason: House recall is free if tax is paid, each house has its own cooldown, and from a house you can then shrine-travel. Official returning-player advice already called this out. The 2026 change raises the useful number of free points from three to five for level 55+ characters, but houses still have a gold purchase cost.

spend_tips.tip: Do not hoard Azoth out of fear of shrine-travel prices the way launch players did; 10/20 per trip is small next to the 2,500 cap and quest income.
spend_tips.reason: February 2022 officially flattened travel to 20 Azoth and removed distance and weight penalties. Later 2024 guides report 10 in-territory and 20 out-of-territory. High Ground Gaming (updated 2024-05-21) explicitly says the low fee ended Azoth scarcity for travel. Still leave a reserve if you craft matrices or invest Azoth in gear.

spend_tips.tip: Pay the house-cooldown reset only when you need a second house teleport before the timer ends.
spend_tips.reason: Official February 2022 cost is 20 Azoth per reset. That is the same as one out-of-territory shrine hop, so it is cheap but unnecessary if you can wait, use another house, or use inn recall.

spend_tips.tip: Do not capture the Restless Shores fort only to save Azoth on travel.
spend_tips.reason: The bonus makes fast travel free (official May 2022; still listed in 2025 guides), but current travel fees are already 10 or 20 Azoth. High Ground Gaming (2024-05-21) says the bonus is probably not worth the PvP effort just for travel savings. It is still useful if your faction already holds the fort.

spend_tips.tip: Stay under the 2,500 wallet cap while leveling if you like, but bank Vials of Suspended Azoth for later crafting rather than opening them into a full wallet you might overflow.
spend_tips.reason: The official cap is 2,500. Each vial is 50 Azoth and is a major input for end-game crafts such as matrix components (250 Azoth per component, plus vial ingredients in some guides). Opening vials only when you are about to craft avoids sitting at the cap. Official 2022 salvage rules were designed so salvage-all would not open more vials than would fit under the cap.

spend_tips.tip: Spend the optional crafting Azoth slider (and 250-Azoth matrix components) on gear you intend to keep, not on throwaway crafts.
spend_tips.reason: Official crafting text says more Azoth only raises the chance of perks or gem slots and does not guarantee them. Matrix components are a confirmed 250 Azoth each as of a July 1, 2025 guide. Eternal Frost also jumped some expansion procedural perk costs to 150 Azoth. That is a large sink relative to the 2,500 cap, so it is worth it for targeted end-game crafts and wasteful for random leveling gear.

spend_tips.tip: Plan weapon trees before mid-mastery if you want to avoid Azoth respec fees; attributes are a coin fee instead.
spend_tips.reason: Official sources confirm weapon-mastery respecs cost Azoth and that 1.0.5 cut that cost by 75%, but they never published a current amount table. Attribute respecs cost coin, not Azoth. Spend Azoth here only when a build change is actually needed.

azoth_staff.summary: In current Aeternum data the Azoth Staff is still a main-story reward, not a normal trade-skill craft. The quest is named An Order Reborn (quest id 99a_msq_11_forgestaff; older database snapshots called it Reignition). At suggested level 24, Yonas Alazar sends you to the forge beneath Shattered Obelisk to bring a new Soulwarden Azoth Staff into being. Live nwdb.info lists the T1 staff, 50 Azoth, 4,000 XP, 269.50 coin, and 5 Common Health Potions as rewards. Higher staff tiers (I–V) exist as separate tool items on the same database and are used to close higher-level Corruption Breaches. Official Season of Opportunity / Aeternum launch notes (2024-10-14) still mention the Azoth Staff (an appearance bug fix), so the item remains in the live client. It is not an optional end-game weapon; it is a quest-granted tool.

sources.notes: Live nwdb.info quest page, undated, accessed 2026-11-15. Lists current name, suggested level 24, and 50 Azoth plus T1 staff.

Older nwdb snapshot of the T5 Azoth Staff tool and its tier family (undated, accessed 2026-11-15). Staff is a quest-reward tool, not a Trading Post craft. Live quest data for the T1 reward is at https://nwdb.info/db/quest/99a_msq_11_forgestaff.
Official Aeternum launch notes include a fix so the Azoth Staff does not appear sheathed at the waist in some circumstances, confirming the item is still in the Aeternum client.

project_azoth_server.note: Project Azoth private server has published no azoth costs as of 2026-11-15
project_azoth_server.notes: The /api/stats payload reports emulator build and packet-resolution counts only. No Azoth cost, cap, or earn values are published there. The required note above remains accurate as of this snapshot.
